Ryfus Sacredpyr (referred to as the Arathi Loremaster by the map marker) is an Arathi located inside the Church of the Sacred Flame in Mereldar, Hallowfall. He offers players a quiz of six questions about Arathi culture. The correct response to each question will only be available if the player has looted the corresponding copy of six of the books scattered around Hallowfall (listed on Biblo Archivist). Correctly answering all six questions unlocks the Loremaster's Reward on the table next to him, containing the Arathi Book Collection toy and a Hallowfall Arathi Commendation worth 150 reputation.

Ryton Blackholme was Hallowfall's finest blacksmith. He trained Raen Dawncavalyr and Lars Bronsmaelt from back when they were but "cubs". He was also Faerin Lothar's mentor and dearest friend. Faerin later led a remembrance for her fallen friend and melted his breastplate in honor.

S.C.R.A.P., or Salvage, Cleanup, and Recl-Amation Patrol, is a goblin organization and a frequent activity in Undermine, made available at Renown 2 with the Cartels of Undermine. The objective is to collectively dig up to 500 times within 2 minutes at a scrap pile watched by Carlo Greasegrind and beset by enemies. Digging will turn up an Empty Kaja'Cola Can or six, which can be traded for rewards alongside the occasional Gunk-Covered Thingy and rare Vintage Kaja'Cola Can.

.]] Sa'bak is a great crocolisk described in tol'vir legends. It's believed that he emerged from Un'Goro Crater and was blessed by the keepers to safeguard the waterways of Uldum. Few people have ever seen him. Crocolisk nests that hatch during the Festival of the Sun are said to be blessed by Sa'bak. The blessed appear as golden creatures with four legs and two wings, rather than the six legs crocolisks normally sport. __NOTOC__

Innkeeper Saelienne is a night elf innkeeper located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved. Years later, Saelienne is found in the Central Encampment under Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream, acting as an innkeeper for the Dream Wardens. After Fyrakk's death, she attended the gathering at Amirdrassil when it bloomed on the Dragon Isles. Afterward, she stayed at Bel'ameth and became the innkeeper of the Silver Feather. After Xal'atath's attack on the Isle of Quel'Danas, Saelienne traveled to the Arcantina to act as a bartender.

Sandals of Torment is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Armor of Torment.

Sanctum of Domination sets are the appearance sets associated with patch 9.1.0 and the Sanctum of Domination, the second raid of . They are visually themed after the raid and offer no set bonuses. There are a total of four Sanctum of Domination appearance sets, one for each armor type. Despite not being proper tier sets, they are sometimes colloquially called Tier 27. Completing one of these sets will grant the Dominating the Catwalk achievement.

Sanctum Assailant's Trappings is the Sanctum of Domination set for leather-wearers. Several items for certain armor slots can count towards collecting the appearance. Some drops from Mor'geth, a world boss in The Maw, can unlock the normal difficulty appearance. Completing the set grants the Dominating the Catwalk achievement.
Sanctified Steps are created with Khaz Algar Blacksmithing. The crafting recipe is taught by Plans: Sanctified Steps.
Sanctified Torchbearer's Grips are created with Khaz Algar Leatherworking. The crafting recipe is taught by Pattern: Sanctified Torchbearer's Grips.
Sandals of Scarred Servitude drop from Nexus-King Salhadaar in Manaforge Omega.
Sandals of the Endless Hunger are a quest reward from Hunger of the Void.
The Sand-Worn Coffer is located at atop a cliff at the Fracture of Laacuna on K'aresh. Looting it is one of the criteria of Treasures of K'aresh
Sand Tornado is bought from Maara in Dornogal in stacks of 5 for .
Sanctified Supplies are looted during the Kyron's Assault story variant of Nightfall Sanctum.

Sand Sculpting Comb can be looted from Laden Earthen Coffers found on the Isle of Dorn.
Sand Lashers are lashers that can be found in Tanaris. They are largely buried under the sand until they get attacked.
Sand Striders are krolusks located near the Oasis and North Sufaad on K'aresh.
